== Story 636: English errata source audit ==
Compared the actual English original/later faces and primary replacement paragraphs. [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, p. 64. [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|SWCCG 2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, edition dated 30 July 2023, p. 113. The original face has a Light Side Force icon, also reproduced in Glossary p. 64 and Appendix A p. 113. The existing original article mislabels it Dark Side, and the current PC article omits its name. These transcripts require correction while preserving their identities. No matching full face was located for the Decipher intermediate. The comparison preserves complete clauses; following ruling paragraphs and attributes supplied only by rules are not inserted into printed Game Text. All observed statistics and uniqueness remain unchanged. Canonical titles, article corrections, documentary states and Versions changes are coordinated with Story 617; this packet proposes shared-table transclusions only. --~~~~
